title: Pastel color does not modulate viewers’ emotions in audiovisual projects
core_idea: Investigate whether pastel versus saturated color production design in audiovisual works (film, TV, advertising) affects viewers' perceived emotions by comparing responses to paired video productions evoking six basic emotions.
tldr: The study created 12 videos (six pastel, six saturated), each designed to evoke one of six basic emotions, and presented them to two groups of viewers to assess whether pastel colors elicit lower emotional intensity than saturated colors.
